brief: The canvas displays an intricate, tangled arrangement of wires and cables, which serve as pathways for luminous data streams. These streams pulse with bright, flowing energy, appearing as electric, vibrant lines of light. The movement is cyclical: the streams converge and gather into highly visible, dense knots at every major junction. Once gathered, this bright energy momentarily splits, sending multiple secondary streams shooting out along the surrounding network pathways before dissipating. The scene is purely dynamic, requiring no input to generate the continuous flow of patterned light.

statement: This sketch creates a dynamic network visualization of interconnected pathways that pulse with flowing energy. The scene features a tangled web of glowing cables connecting randomly positioned junctions, where luminous data streams travel along the connections. At various points throughout the animation, these junctions gather energy into bright, expanding knots before splitting into multiple secondary streams that radiate outward. The system operates purely autonomously, generating continuous, evolving patterns without user interaction, with streams flowing in and out of the junction points in a cyclical rhythm that creates an organic, living network effect.
